awaken.configuration.statusStyle.tooltip: HOLO: the Status screen (K) unfolds from a band on your wrist and floats in front of you. FLAT: the classic flat screen. FLAT is also used if the holo shaders can't load.
awaken.configuration.hudMotion.tooltip: How far Awaken's HUD drifts when you turn sharply: OFF, SUBTLE (about 2 pixels) or FULL (4). Follows Screen Effect Scale; off when View Bobbing is off. The vanilla hotbar never moves.
awaken.configuration.inventoryStyle.tool: HOLO: the inventory (E) unfolds from the band on your wrist as a holo panel. VANILLA: Minecraft's own inventory. HOLO needs the Status screen style HOLO; every click, drag and shift-click works the same either way.
awaken.configuration.reducedMotion.toolt: Holo panels follow your view directly instead of trailing it, and fade in place instead of unfolding.
